title: Design of a Biaxial Mechanical Loading Bioreactor for Tissue Engineering
protocol: Mount the device on a rigid 25 cm x 30 cm x 12.5 mm aluminum base plate.
Use adjustable kinematic stops to lock tissue culture plates in place.
Adjust fine adjustment screws for precise alignment of tissue culture plates.
Place kinematic stops flexibly to accommodate different sizes and shapes of plates.
Couple a custom-machined polysulfone loading platen to the bi-axial moving platform via a precision-machined right angle bracket.
Choose polysulfone material due to its biocompatibility, ease of machining, and sterilization properties.
Control movements of the stages using Thor-labs' Advanced Positioning Technology (APT) software.
Use stepper motor driver in combination with APT software for load parameter adjustment.
Mix 0.8 g of agarose with 20 ml of DMEM without additives in a 50 ml flask.
Boil the mixture and keep it in a 70 °C oven until needed.
Adjust the volume of the cell suspension to achieve the desired seeding density.
Combine the adjusted cell suspension with an equal volume of 4% agarose solution to create a 2% agarose gel at the desired seeding density.
Place the cell suspension and one 10 ml pipette in the incubator.
Set up the gel casting system using a 1.5 mm spacer plate and a 0.75 mm spacer plate to create a 2.25 mm thick gel.
Securely tape the spacer plates together to prevent leaking.
Remove liquid agarose from the oven and place a sterile thermometer in it to cool to 42-43 °C.
Warm up the cell suspension to 37 °C.
Quickly mix the desired amount of cooled agarose with the cell suspension by pipetting up and down several times.
Immediately pipette the entire mixture into the gel mold.
Allow the gel to solidify for 10-15 minutes.
Tilt the gel mold horizontally once solidified.
Remove the top glass plate from the gel mold.
Punch disks out of the gel using a biopsy punch.
Pick up each disk with a small sterile spatula.
Place one disk in each well of a 24-well non-tissue culture treated plate.
Add 2 ml of serum-free chondrogenic differentiation medium to each well containing a disk.
Put the plates into the incubator (37 °C, 5% CO2).
Replace 1 ml per well every 2-3 days for media changes.
Prepare 4% agarose without adding cell suspension.
Ensure agarose gel thickness is between 1.5-1.9 mm.
Punch 16 mm diameter disks from the gelled agarose for 24 well plates.
In each disk, punch one 5 mm hole to accommodate the sample.
Optionally, punch another 5 mm hole on the edge of the disk for pipette access during media changes.
Place punched agarose wells in a 24 well plate.
Press fit samples into each well so they protrude from the top of the agarose well.
Sterilize platen before use.
Secure aluminum plate to load cell.
Attach loading platen/load cell/aluminum plate assembly to the stage.
Turn on stepper motor controller.
Power on PC and open "APT User" program.
Use left screen for controlling horizontal stepper motor manually via "Graphical Control" tab.
Control vertical stepper motor using right screen in "Graphical Control" tab.
Each screen’s "Move Sequencer" tab allows for automated control.
Both stepper motors have a range of 50 mm.
Press "Home/Zero" button on both screens to send stepper motors to the zero position.
Remove some media from each well in the 24-well plate.
Ensure no more than 1 ml of media remains in each well.
Leave enough media to keep the sample covered.
Place the 24-well plate in the bioreactor.
Line up the plate with the platen using the two pre-positioned left locators.
Tighten the two right locators to secure the plate.
Align the plate flush with the front of the bioreactor base.
Manually enter a specific stepper motor position in the "Graphical Control" tab.
Lower the platen slowly and horizontally to line up with the plate.
Bring the platen down in very slow increments (0.1 mm) until reaching the predetermined starting position.
Load the desired move sequence in the "Move Sequencer" tab by pressing "Load."
Start the process by pressing "Run" on the "Move Sequencer" tab.
Manually raise the platen once loading is complete.
Carefully put any stuck samples back into their appropriate wells using a sterile spatula.
Remove 24 well plate from bioreactor.
Replace the media in the removed plate.
Carefully remove the platen from the load cell.
Turn off instruments after removing platen.
Manually put horizontal stepper motor at the 25 mm position.
Lower platen until it just barely comes in contact with the base of the bioreactor.
Take note of the exact position of the vertical stepper motor.
Record the position for calibration reference.
Define tare compressive strain as 10% of sample thickness.
Choose dynamic strain amplitude and loading frequency based on sample requirements.
Compute desired vertical positions based on dosing protocol and platen calibration value.
Experiment with acceleration and maximum velocity values to achieve the correct frequency.
Choose the number of cycles accordingly (e.g., 10,800 cycles for 3 hr at 1 Hz).
